verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a review outcome that routes transactions into case management, where a reviewer opens the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects it (docs-1, docs-9). That covers the review-queue core. Triggered risk rules are exposed in webhooks and payment responses (docs-16), and Shopper DNA links related shoppers (docs-11), but neither is shown to appear inside the review case view. Missing for 10: evidence that the case view shows customer history, triggered signals and similar or linked cases in one place, plus tools for consistent decisions (e.g. guidance or reason codes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reviewer experience.
